toegepas.voor: ses buurlande by die naam, met hul grense:
toegepas.na: ses buurlande, met hul name en grense:
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'by die naam' calques English 'by name'; 'met hul name en grense' says the same thing naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'by die naam' copies English 'by name' and reads oddly for labelling countries on a map.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'met hul name en grense' says the same thing in natural Afrikaans and touches no protected wording.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The impersonal 'sodat te sien is' is stiff; an active phrasing reads more naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'sodat te sien is dat' is stiff and lacks the 'dit' it would normally carry.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sodat 'n mens kan sien dat' is the natural phrasing and leaves the protected directions untouched.

toegepas.voor: Namibië en Mosambiek se kus sigbaar is
toegepas.na: Namibië en Mosambiek se kuste sigbaar is
toegepas.rede_vinder: Two countries each have their own coast, so the plural 'kuste' is needed.
toegepas.fout: 'Namibie en Mosambiek se kus' can be read as one shared coast, though the two countries have separate coasts on different oceans.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The plural 'kuste' is grammatically exact and matches the lesson's point that each lies on a different ocean.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daarvandaan' is the natural Afrikaans form; 'Van daar' without 'af' reads clipped.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Van daar' is ordinary, correct Afrikaans and reads clearly at Grade 5, so 'Daarvandaan' is a lateral swap.
